purpose: Source directory for medicine identity, product labels, national regulatory context, safety-list discovery, and potential licensed interaction screening. None of these sources alone constitutes a patient-specific prescribing recommendation.
policy: Separate source discovery, medicine identity, regulatory status, labels, interaction screening, and clinical guideline decisions.
No source record is automatically a clinically approved evidence card.
Do not infer 'no interaction' from a missing response, ambiguous medication identity, unsupported product, or failed provider call.
Do not ingest or redistribute full text without verifying record-specific rights and provider terms.

sources.title: RxNorm API
sources.content_rights: non_proprietary_RxNorm_content; RxClass includes SNOMED CT subject to separate terms
sources.attribution: This product uses publicly available data from the U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM), National Institutes of Health, Department of Health and Human Services; NLM is not responsible for the product and does not endorse or recommend this or any other product.
limits: NLM API terms include rate limits and caching recommendations; follow current terms.
RxNav's Drug-Drug Interaction API was discontinued January 2, 2024.
Does not provide a complete drug-interaction screening service or patient-specific prescribing recommendation.

sources.title: openFDA Drug Product Labeling API
sources.attribution: Data provided by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (https://open.fda.gov)
limits: FDA states that openFDA data has limitations and should not be used alone to make medical-care decisions.
Some records include private-party material whose rights are limited; separately review or exclude those records.
Submitted labeling can differ from the currently distributed or approved product labeling.
Do not copy full label text into the curated knowledge base by default; display metadata and a link to the source record.

sources.title: DailyMed SPL Web Services
limits: Use SPL set IDs and version history to identify the exact product-label version.
Do not assume public access authorizes bulk redistribution of all label content; check record-specific rights notices.
A label reference does not replace patient-specific clinical assessment or local jurisdiction checks.

sources.title: Drugs@FDA Database and openFDA Drugs@FDA API
sources.update_policy: FDA reports daily updates Monday through Friday for openFDA Drugs@FDA data
limits: US regulatory context only; does not establish Egyptian registration, availability, or prescribing rules.
Approval metadata is not a dental clinical guideline, dose calculation, or interaction checker.

sources.title: DrugBank Clinical API — Medication Search and Drug-Drug Interactions
limits: Not currently connected, configured, tested, or validated in Mia.
Confirm country coverage, allowed display/storage, source provenance, refresh process, uptime, clinical liability, data-processing terms, and cost before integration.
A missing, ambiguous, or unavailable response must not be interpreted as a negative interaction result.

sources.title: CDC dental antibiotic prescribing and stewardship resources
sources.publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.commercial_use_status: candidate_for_review_of_government_authored_content; verify exact artifact and embedded rights
limits: CDC page updated September 17, 2026; recheck the current page and exact downloadable artifact.
Scope depends on the specific population and clinical question in the underlying resource.
Must be reviewed by a qualified dentist before a product evidence card is approved.

sources.title: ADA dental clinical practice guidelines, acute pain, and antibiotic stewardship
limits: Use the exact guideline page, publication, intended population, and version.
Free online access is not permission to copy or embed full text.
Each derived card requires scope, supersession, rights, and qualified clinician review.

sources.title: AAPD Reference Manual — Pediatric pain management and antibiotic therapy
limits: Verify the current Reference Manual edition and the exact recommendation artifact.
Pediatric sources must not be treated as interchangeable with adult guidance.
No pediatric dose card may be approved without qualified review of age, weight, formulation, route, and source-specific limits.

sources.title: AAE Clinical Guidelines and Position Statements
limits: Link the exact guideline and edition used.
Do not derive a medication recommendation from a general resource index.

sources.title: Egyptian Drug Register
limits: The official public page lists drug-register chapters by class/year; no supported public API contract has been verified.
Do not scrape at scale or infer current registration/availability without confirming the exact product and current record.
US FDA approval data must not be used as a substitute for Egyptian regulatory status.

sources.title: Egyptian Drug Authority Periodic Pharmaceutical Lists
limits: Record the exact edition and publication date for each list used.
These lists provide regulatory/safety context, not patient-specific treatment choices or interaction screening.

sources.title: Egyptian Pharmaceutical Information Center — reliable drug information inquiry
limits: This is a human information service, not an API or a source for bulk corpus ingestion.
Do not submit identifiable patient information without an approved legal and privacy process.

sources.title: Egypt: National Essential Medicine List 2025 (English)
limits: An essential-medicine list is not a patient-specific prescribing guideline, interaction database, or proof of current product stock.
Do not apply it to a US workflow.

sources.title: RxNav Drug-Drug Interaction API
limits: NLM states the RxNav drug-drug interaction features were discontinued on January 2, 2024.
